name: create_ryzome_document
description: Create a standalone Ryzome document that appears in the library. The result starts with a 'View: <url>' line — include that URL verbatim in your reply so the user can open the document.

id.description: Optional caller-supplied 24-hex id for the document

tags.description: Tags appended to the created document (deduplicated)

header.description: Line prepended to Text content, followed by a blank line (documents and new canvas nodes)

provenance.description: Provenance metadata stamped onto created documents

nodes.description: Must be empty; add nodes with canvas tools

edges.description: Must be empty; add edges with canvas tools

name: create_ryzome_canvas
description: Create a Ryzome canvas with explicitly defined nodes and edges. Nodes either create a new text document (title + description) or reference an existing document (documentId). Positions are computed automatically unless x/y/width/height are given per node. The result starts with a 'View: <url>' line — include that URL verbatim in your reply so the user can open the canvas.

id.description: Optional caller-supplied 24-hex id for the canvas document

tags.description: Tags appended to the created document (deduplicated)

header.description: Line prepended to Text content, followed by a blank line (documents and new canvas nodes)

provenance.description: Provenance metadata stamped onto created documents

id.description: Unique node identifier (local to this call)

nodeId.description: Optional caller-supplied 24-hex id for the canvas node and any new backing document

documentId.description: Reference an existing document by id instead of creating a new one

group.description: ID of the group this node belongs to

nodes.description: Nodes to place on the canvas

id.description: Optional caller-supplied 24-hex id for the edge

groups.description: Groups that visually contain nodes. Nodes reference a group by its id.

title.description: Group label displayed on the frame

name: get_ryzome_document
description: Retrieve a standalone Ryzome document by its ID.

document_id.description: The ID of the document to retrieve

name: get_ryzome_canvas
description: Retrieve a Ryzome canvas by its ID, including all nodes and edges.

canvas_id.description: The ID of the canvas to retrieve

name: list_ryzome_documents
description: List standalone Ryzome documents, optionally filtered by library visibility, favorites, tags, or content type.

tag.description: Filter to documents containing this tag

favorite.description: Filter to favorite documents if true

in_library_only.description: Only return documents visible in the library (defaults to true)

content_types.description: Filter to these document content types

name: list_ryzome_canvases
description: List all Ryzome canvases accessible to the current user. Returns canvas names, IDs, and descriptions.

pinned.description: Filter to only pinned canvases if true

name: create_ryzome_plan
description: Create a Ryzome canvas from a plan. Steps are auto-chained in order by default; optionally set id and dependsOn to express branching or merging. The result starts with a 'View: <url>' line — include that URL verbatim in your reply so the user can open the canvas.

id.description: Optional caller-supplied 24-hex id for the canvas document

tags.description: Tags appended to the created document (deduplicated)

header.description: Line prepended to Text content, followed by a blank line (documents and new canvas nodes)

provenance.description: Provenance metadata stamped onto created documents

dependsOn.description: IDs of steps this step depends on (defaults to previous step)

nodeId.description: Optional caller-supplied 24-hex id for the canvas node and any new backing document

group.description: ID of the group this step belongs to

steps.description: Steps to chain into a plan

title.description: Group label displayed on the frame

name: create_ryzome_research
description: Create a Ryzome canvas displaying research findings. Control layout by setting dependsOn on findings (reference 'topic' for the root node or other finding ids). The result starts with a 'View: <url>' line — include that URL verbatim in your reply so the user can open the canvas.

id.description: Optional caller-supplied 24-hex id for the canvas document

tags.description: Tags appended to the created document (deduplicated)

header.description: Line prepended to Text content, followed by a blank line (documents and new canvas nodes)

provenance.description: Provenance metadata stamped onto created documents

dependsOn.description: IDs of nodes this finding depends on (use 'topic' to connect to root)

nodeId.description: Optional caller-supplied 24-hex id for the canvas node and any new backing document

group.description: ID of the group this finding belongs to

title.description: Group label displayed on the frame

name: update_ryzome_document
description: Update a standalone Ryzome document using document operations and metadata changes. Tags can only be set when creating a document.

document_id.description: The ID of the document to update

nodes.description: Must be empty; add nodes with canvas tools

edges.description: Must be empty; add edges with canvas tools

append_text.description: Append text to a Text document

in_library.description: Control whether the document appears in the library

thumbnail_s3_key.description: Set the thumbnail S3 key for the document

name: save_ryzome_node_to_library
description: Promote an existing canvas node's backing document into the library.

canvas_id.description: The ID of the canvas containing the node

node_id.description: The ID of the node to save to the library

name: upload_ryzome_image
description: Upload an image from a URL to an existing Ryzome canvas. Fetches the image, uploads it to storage, and creates an image node on the canvas.

canvas_id.description: The ID of the canvas to add the image to

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to upload

name: update_ryzome_canvas
description: Apply canvas operations to an existing Ryzome canvas: setName, createNode (Group | ExistingDocument | NewDocument), setNodePosition, setNodeSize, setNodeTitle, setNodeColor, setNodeContent, appendNodeContent, setNodeFavoriteState, deleteNode, createEdge, setEdgeLabel, setEdgePosition, deleteEdge. Operations are submitted in order in one request and are not automatically retried. Read back the canvas after an uncertain failure. Content supports Text, File, Youtube, Website, or an empty Canvas; use bundle tools for bundle content.

canvas_id.description: ID of the canvas to update

id.description: Optional 24-hex id for the new backing document

nodes.description: Must be empty; add nodes with canvas tools

edges.description: Must be empty; add edges with canvas tools

nodes.description: Must be empty; add nodes with canvas tools

edges.description: Must be empty; add edges with canvas tools

name: verify_ryzome_structure
description: Read back a Ryzome bundle or canvas and report its structure: member/node/edge counts, unavailable members or nodes (NotFound, Unauthorized, Error), optional labeling advisories, and edges referencing unknown node ids. Read-only; makes no changes.

document_id.description: ID of the bundle or canvas document to verify

name: create_ryzome_bundle
description: Create an ordered Ryzome bundle containing existing documents. Include the returned View URL in your reply.

id.description: Optional caller-supplied 24-hex id for the bundle document

provenance.description: Provenance metadata; only `tags` applies to bundles (they have no text content)

tags.description: Tags appended to the created document (deduplicated)

header.description: Line prepended to Text content, followed by a blank line (documents and new canvas nodes)

document_ids.description: Existing document IDs in initial order

name: get_ryzome_bundle
description: Read a Ryzome bundle and its ordered document metadata, including unavailable members.

name: update_ryzome_bundle
description: Add, remove, or reorder documents in a Ryzome bundle. Removing membership does not delete the document. Reordering must include every current member exactly once. System bundles enforce server restrictions.

name: create_ryzome_conversation
description: Create an empty Ryzome conversation (thread). Include the returned View URL in your reply.

id.description: Optional caller-supplied 24-hex id for the conversation

context.description: Existing document IDs to attach as initial context

name: get_ryzome_conversation
description: Read a Ryzome conversation with its attached context and full message history.

name: list_ryzome_conversations
description: List Ryzome conversations, optionally filtered to pinned ones.

pinned.description: Only return pinned conversations if true

name: update_ryzome_conversation
description: Update a Ryzome conversation's title, pinned state, or context. Setting context replaces the attached documents; removed_context marks documents as removed without deleting them.

context.description: Replace the attached context documents with these IDs

removed_context.description: Mark these document IDs as removed from context

name: add_ryzome_conversation_message
description: Append a user message to a Ryzome conversation, optionally attaching documents as context. Returns the updated conversation.

context.description: Existing document IDs to attach as context

name: search_ryzome_conversations
description: Search Ryzome conversations by title or message content.

name: delete_ryzome_conversation
description: Delete Ryzome conversations by ID. The caller must own the conversations.
